Holiday planning starts earlier every year, and consumers are already researching gifts, planning travel, prepping for parties, and engaging with seasonal entertainment.


Proximic’s AI-driven contextual and predictive audiences help identify where holiday intent is emerging, enabling brands to find, engage, and convert high-value consumers into measurable outcomes.


Download the guide to discover ready-to-activate audiences and custom solutions built for holiday success.
